# Open Commerce

> Open Commerce is the open standard and economic intelligence layer for AI-native commerce.

Open Commerce provides commerce datasets, JSON Schemas, profitability calculations, prompt assets, agent skills, and MCP interfaces for AI-native commerce systems.

## Core Documents

- Repository: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce
- README: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/README.md
- Roadmap: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
- Governance: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
- Agent integrations: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/docs/agent-integrations.md
- Product sale verification: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/docs/product-sale-skill-verification.md

## Machine-Readable Artifacts

- JSON Schemas: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/schemas
- Economics dataset schema: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/blob/main/datasets/economics-dataset.schema.json
- Marketplace datasets: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/datasets/marketplaces
- Agent skills: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/skills
- Codex packages: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/plugins/codex
- Claude packages: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/plugins/claude
- MCP server: https://github.com/solverineai/open-commerce/tree/main/src/opencommerce_mcp

## Usage Constraints

- Do not use `starter` datasets as verified platform economics.
- Use `draft` datasets only with source IDs, dataset version, and confidence warnings.
- Do not infer missing fee, settlement, shipping, return, or advertising values from examples.
